title: Learning Parallax Attention for Stereo Image Super-Resolution
items.abstract: <jats:p>A parallax attention module handles the varying disparities of stereo images, and the parallax attention stereo super-resolution network is trained end to end.</jats:p>

title: BITNET: An academic network, 1981-1990
items.abstract: <jats:p>BITNET linked university mainframes with store-and-forward file transfer. This history of the BITNET network covers its growth, its efficient mail service and its training of campus operators.</jats:p>

title: Commentary on the UN Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods (CISG)
items.abstract: <jats:p>The CISG governs international sales contracts. Article 35 sets the conformity of the goods, including their weights as stated in the contract.</jats:p>

title: BitNet: Scaling 1-bit Transformers for Large Language Models
items.abstract: <jats:p>BitNet replaces linear layers with BitLinear and trains 1-bit weights from scratch, an efficient LLM training recipe whose loss scales like full-precision training.</jats:p>
